control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60 then {if LLIGHT < 45 curve left; else if line tracker > 95 % curve right; else avoidWalls} else avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 then {if obstacle LEFT turn right 20°; else if obstacle RIGHT turn left 20°; else driveInTheDark} else driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward at 30 %; else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if obstacle FRONT stop; else followLine.
followLine: if line tracker sees black curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line if one is under the robot, and drive straight if there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.

decision_points.condition: RLIGHT is below 60 % (it is fairly dark)

branches.outcome: RLIGHT below 60 %: it goes on into the dark logic
RLIGHT 60 % or more (bright): it calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: first LLIGHT < 45 %; second the line tracker reads more than 95 % (white band)

branches.outcome: LLIGHT below 45 % (deep dark): it curves left 15/35, ignoring the line
LLIGHT 45 % or more and the tracker reads above 95 %: it curves right 35/15
LLIGHT 45 % or more and the tracker not above 95 %: it calls avoidWalls
LLIGHT below 70 %: it checks obstacles LEFT and RIGHT
LLIGHT 70 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first an obstacle on the LEFT; second an obstacle on the RIGHT

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: it turns right 20°
an obstacle on the right: it turns left 20°
no obstacle on either side: it calls driveInTheDark
LLIGHT below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
LLIGHT 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall
doesn't see black: it curves right 40/10
